originalTitle: Review & Preview: Nvidia to the Rescue?
summary: The stock market was essentially a waiting room for Nvidia’s earnings report, which came after the bell. At 13.61 billion shares traded, volume on U.S. exchanges hit the second-lowest level of the year, according to Dow Jones Market Data. “Most investors seem content to sit on their hands and wait for the print rather than put on meaningful risk ahead of what is arguably the most important earnings report of the quarter,” he writes.
